task: Fix a real bug: the sheet drag handle showed a full-width grey fill on hover/press because the base button:hover rule wasn't overridden for the handle's interactive states

public/styles/responsive.css.summary: Added .quickPanelHandle:hover/:active/:focus-visible { background: transparent } -- base.css's global button:hover rule (background: rgba(255,255,255,0.11)) was painting the whole 24px-tall, full-width handle on hover/press, which is exactly the chunky-bar look the handle redesign was meant to avoid. Only the grip's own opacity should visibly react to interaction, not the surrounding strip.

test/public/style.test.js.summary: Added an assertion for the new hover/active/focus-visible transparent-background override.
